summary: Emerald Holding filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by funds managed by Apollo Global Management. Under the agreement, each share of common stock will be canceled and converted into the right to receive cash, though the exact per-share price is not stated in the excerpt. The board unanimously approved and recommends the deal. Stockholders affiliated with Onex Corporation, holding over 90% voting power, have already adopted the agreement via written consent, effectively approving the merger. The transaction is structured as a tender offer followed by a merger, with regulatory approvals required. Watch for stockholder appraisal rights and the expected close timeline.
